items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: That was a date for Columbia. He had a contract for Columbia. They gave him – George Butler gave him a contract – a date. Dave Holland was a couple of hours late, snow or something like that. I remember it.
Yep. Very disorganized date, because Aydin is kind of loose. He’s like a mad genius running around the room.
